mentions.name: PulpitBase
mentions.description: A platform for watching and sharing sermons, with an integrated Bible reader that supports basic study of scripture.
mentions.problem: The author, a Christian and software engineer who occasionally gets asked to preach, lacked tools to help with preaching and sharing sermons, so he built his own.
mentions.audience: The author is a Christian software engineer who occasionally gets asked to preach and built it to scratch his own itch.
mentions.source_excerpt: It's basically a place to watch and share sermons and I built in a basic bible reader too that can be used for basic study of scripture
mentions.author: jngbtmbwc
